sentences.en: Some people want to bring about amendments to the constitution.
sentences.zh: 有些人想对宪法进行修改。

sentences.en: It's not every day that Congress ratifies a new amendment.
sentences.zh: 国会不会经常批准新的修正案。

sentences.en: Some claim that full-body scanners violate the Fourth Amendment.
sentences.zh: 有人认为全身扫描仪违反了第四修正案。

senses.zh: 修正，修订之处；美国宪法修正案（Amendment）；（土壤结构或肥力的）改善；（对文件或计划的）修改
